g.text: Which routes allow alignment in the model?

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #202b33

g.text: 31 phase entries × 18 routes. Each cell retains its assumptions and proposed test in account.csv.

g.text: FP field-aligned particles MO shape-aligned particles FS field solidification DS directional solidification

g.text: AM additive manufacturing FA field ageing SA stress ageing RX rolled/recrystallised parent SC single crystal

g.text: These are conditional model limits. A high ceiling does not establish a viable bulk process or sufficient coercivity.
